# close

common

open override fun [close](close.html)()

Blocking [AutoCloseable](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-auto-closeable/index.html) bridge to [closeSession](close-session.html), for callers outside a coroutine.

Coroutine code must call [closeSession](close-session.html) instead, typically in a `finally`, and nothing should call this from a main thread, because it blocks until the graceful close finishes. Unlike the GenAI SDK's `LiveSession.close()`, which cancels the socket abruptly, this closes gracefully.
